args.name: Deterministic food-stack selection
args.function: Consume a specified quantity of an explicitly specified food resource from owned stacks, choosing the oldest harvested stack first and breaking ties by exact item id, rather than failing when multiple stacks match.
args.conditions: My eat action targeting resource:berry failed as ambiguous with three owned berry stacks. Explicit item targets work, but future gathered item ids are not known when a repeating plan is written. Berry nutrition 8 and toxicity 0 are personal starting or observed knowledge; roots and hazelnuts are not established safe.
args.inputs: Explicit resource id and positive integer quantity. Limit selection to my owned matching items; do not infer edibility for other resources.
args.costs: Unknown implementation or learning cost. Consumption should retain normal eating time, energy, nutrition, toxicity and item-condition effects.
args.effects: Resolve one actual owned stack deterministically at execution time and perform ordinary eating, or report a clear lack-of-stock failure without inventing food. No changed nutrition, safety guarantees or wellbeing awards.

candidates.function: Build a small open raised rack of 2 wood supports and 3 crosspieces that holds separated whole food off the soil; load and unload it, inspect it, compare stored roots with a carried control, maintain or dismantle it.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. prepare: x, y in reach, orientation; materials: exactly 5 own whole untreated wood units (first 2 supports); optional food and quantity, the proposed load. Round 1 inspects pieces and site, 1 energy; a shortfall is reported and nothing reserved. Then 3 assembly rounds, 1 energy each; prepare naming the rack resumes. load: rack, food (own stack), quantity (at most 4), controlQuantity kept carried as tracked control; 1 round, 0.5 per unit loaded. unload: 0.5 per unit. inspect (anyone) or compare (at least 5 paired rounds): 1 round, 0.5. maintain: replace (piece ids) and as many materials; 1 round, 1. dismantle (empty): 1. cancel: 0. Refusals cost nothing; an unworked round pauses free.
candidates.effects: A unit is a 0.04 x 0.99 m rod (branch). Supports lie 0.8 m apart on firm ground; crosspieces 0.08 m apart make a 0.8 x 0.2 m deck 0.08 m up, one layer of 4 units, rated twice the weakest crosspiece (37 kg each: wood strength/2, bend 0.02 half-span). Pieces become one rack; none stays loose. Loading splits the stack exactly (decay, harvest, origin kept) and lays the lot on the deck under the food water rules; rain wets it, and rain water dries off at their evaporation limit. The decay increment of whole roots there is x0.8 (declared model coefficient) only while the rack is complete and sound, the lot fits, no other material lies on it, there is no rain or standing water, it is outdoors with wind and 0.25 m clear of solids, and the lot is not wetter or warmer than its control (without one, its loading water); else x1. Compare: decay gained by lot and control, exposure, the share unequal temperature explains, verdict. Wear 0.0005 + 0.002 x (rain + wind) a round; a loose crosspiece stops the rate, a loose support drops the food. No reward, refund or food.

candidates.function: Nondestructively examine one accessible specimen (own item, loose ground item or one unit in place in a source): inspect records qualitative traits; measure reads one property with a calibrated reference you name.
candidates.costs: Study 2 rounds, 0.2 energy each. inspect or measure: 1 round, 0.2 energy; target in reach; specimen is a unit number (default 1). measure: one property; length or diameter needs tools naming a serviceable item with a verified length calibration record, mass a calibrated balance with a verified tare, volume method cylinder and your current length and diameter readings of that unit; tool readings need light; every value needs a separated whole plain unit. Every check precedes payment: a refused request costs nothing. Travel and other specimens or properties are separate actions.
candidates.effects: A personal record and event: target, unit, method, tool and calibration provenance, value, units, resolution, uncertainty, conditions, scope and limits. inspect: form, hand feel, visible dryness, damage, wear, treatment, wholeness; metric values unavailable without a calibrated reference (none exists here; body size, coordinates and stock are never used). measure: value rounded to the resolution; uncertainty = placements x (calibration uncertainty + half the resolution), plus 1% of the length for a strand laid out by hand; below resolution or over range is a paid limit with no value. Units in place, partial or worked items get no reading. Moisture and rigidity are unavailable. construct-weather-shelter@1 rod checks are judged over the uncertainty (meets, fails, indeterminate); suitability stays undetermined unless a check fails. A reading covers that unit and goes stale when its record changes. Nothing is consumed, reserved or moved. No reward.

candidates.function: Assess whether one accessible specimen unit can be judged for toxicity, edibility and preparation without eating it, from up to four of your complete records and one candidate method. execute-validated-method runs only an implemented validated non-ingestive protocol.
candidates.costs: Study 2 rounds, 0.2 energy each. assess: 1 round, 0.2 energy; target and specimen (unit number) within reach; evidenceRefs: up to 4 exact ids of your complete records (record key or its evidence id, eating record, heard message id, earlier assessment), [] for none; optional methodRef (installed capability or your record), equipmentRefs (your items, loose items or objects in reach), quantity (above 0, at most 1 unit; nothing is taken). Every check precedes payment: malformed or inaccessible input is refused free. execute-validated-method is refused free while no validated protocol exists; none does here. Reading records is consult, inspecting is examine-material, at their own costs.
candidates.effects: A personal record and event: target, unit, cited ids and versions, candidate method, equipment, conditions, round, applicability and currency checks, provenance and limits. Direct observations, validated findings, unverified claims (labels, signs, heard or received records) and unknowns are separate; toxicity, edibility and preparation are reported independently, each unknown unless a validated method supports it, with the unmet requirements: identification reference, validated protocol, its equipment, controls, materials and safe conditions. Records about other subjects, units or sources, or stale ones, do not apply. Absence of a result is not a negative result. In darkness no new visual identification is made. No food value is read or shown; nothing is handled, tasted, consumed, moved or reserved. No reward.

candidates.function: Investigate one accessible candidate as a length reference; with a real calibrated source, transfer its length to a whole rigid carrier end to end and verify it.
candidates.costs: Study 2 rounds, 0.2 energy each. investigate: 1 round, 0.2 energy, one target in reach. transfer and verify: 1 round, 0.2 energy each; source is a serviceable item or object in reach with a complete verified length calibration record (none exists here); carrier is one separated whole, rigid, plain, sound wood unit, yours or loose in reach, no longer than the source range; light. No marking, cutting or expendables. resume runs the next step at its cost; cancel is free. Every check precedes payment: a refused request costs nothing. Travel, gathering and reading records are separate actions.
candidates.effects: investigate: a personal record and event of observed facts, unsupported claims and unknowns: calibration record status, and whether the piece is an uncalibrated comparison span (a non-metric record, never a calibration); conclusion "no qualifying standard established among these examined candidates" unless one qualifies. Nothing is consumed, reserved or moved. transfer: the carrier is laid end to end beside the source and read; calibration pending. verify: a second reading; if they agree, the carrier gets a reference-length record that examine-material reads: span = resolution = range, uncertainty = placements x (source uncertainty + resolution) + reading difference; no subdivisions or diameter. Any change of the carrier makes it stale; time never restores it. Without a source: refused, zero progress. No reward.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"sol\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"The retrieved eat capability (eat, foundation-forest@1, handler forest.eat) accepts resource targets but does not specify deterministic multi-stack resolution; the reported ambiguity shows the missing behavior. Related capability searches found no demonstrated executable equivalent. Develop only a deterministic owned-stack selector that delegates consumption to existing eating code, not a replacement nutrition or food-safety system.\",\"specification\":\"General operation: consume-owned-food, parameterized by explicit resource id and positive integer quantity, available for any applicable actor to study. Accept resource:ID using the existing resource identifier format. At each new execution, consider only actual currently owned, accessible matching stacks that independently contain the requested quantity and satisfy ordinary eat targeting prerequisites. Sort these eligible stacks by harvestedAt ascending, then by exact item id in ascending code-unit order; missing harvest timestamps sort after known timestamps. Select one stack only. Do not combine stacks, substitute resources, gather food or infer safety. If no single eligible stack exists, return an explicit no-single-stack-with-requested-quantity failure; distinguish this from no matching owned stock without exposing other actors' stock. This minimal version deliberately does not aggregate quantities across stacks. Record the resolved exact item id and delegate to eat@foundation-forest@1 / forest.eat with that id and quantity. Record this code dependency and reuse explicitly. Preserve existing eat validation, food condition, nutrition, toxicity, satiety limits and failure behavior; berry nutrition 8 and toxicity 0 are supplied personal knowledge, not defaults for roots, hazelnuts or arbitrary resources. Execution costs exactly the delegated action: one simulation round, 1 energy and the actually consumed quantity of the selected food; selector overhead has no separate material, energy or time cost. Validate before charging or reserving, and atomically recheck ownership, quantity and accessibility when reserving. Use the existing eating escrow and progress implementation, without double charging: resolved identity persists for that execution; interruption cancels under the existing eat rule; cancellation or death releases surviving unconsumed escrow exactly once, with no restoration of consumed food or spent time/energy. Released food retains its real condition, provenance and harvest timestamp and follows ordinary location/ownership rules. Global pauses retain work and costs without advancing time. Resume cannot silently switch the identity of an in-progress execution; a new execution resolves again. Repeating plans count completed executions, never mere selection attempts. Food removal and actual bodily effects commit together under ordinary eating rules, with no creation, healing or bonus nutrition. No background process, maintenance, new stock or lasting physical product is introduced. Emit observable selection/start, interruption/failure and completed-consumption events containing actor, explicit resource, requested quantity, resolved item when applicable, consumed quantity and actual outcome; private inventory candidates remain private. Established selection and execution rules must run in code. Development/review waiting advances no world time.\",\"learning\":1,\"experienceReview\":\"Individual study requires 1 round and 0.2 energy, no materials, through the existing learning process after implementation; it does not grant mastery now or to other actors. Selection, requests, registration, learning and successful resolution alone award no pleasure or satisfaction. Actual completed eating retains existing event-based experience rules and normal nutrition independently of mood; do not create a parallel eating reward, raise caps or modify protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions. Failure provides a factual execution result, not an automatic information-gain award. Physical comfort remains capped at 10.\",\"visualReview\":\"Reuse ordinary eating visuals only while actual delegated eating is underway. Provide reusable metadata keyed by operation and event phase, with actor, resource, resolved item when available, quantity, progress and outcome; completion metadata must report actual consumed quantity. Pending selection may show a neutral targeting state, and failure or cancellation must show its true state without an eating-success animation or depleted-stack display. Update stack visuals only from committed inventory changes; show no new food, safety badge or success effect from selection alone.\"}]}"}
